imageDescription: A man in business attire is sitting at a desk in an office, reviewing documents. There is a laptop open in front of him.
imageDescriptionJa: ビジネススーツの男性がオフィスのデスクに座り、書類を確認している。前にノートパソコンが開いている。
choices: The man is reading a book on the floor.
The man is reviewing papers at his desk.
The man is talking on the phone outside.
The man is preparing coffee in the kitchen.
explanation: (B) reviewing papers at his desk が「デスクで書類を確認している」状況と一致。(A) は本ではなく書類、(C) 電話していない、(D) 場所が異なる。

question: Where did you put the meeting agenda?
explanation: Where 疑問文には「場所」で答える。(A) On your desk が場所を示し正答。(B) は Did you...? への応答、(C) は質問の意図と無関係。

conversation.speaker: M
conversation.line: Hi Sarah, did you finish the quarterly sales report?

conversation.speaker: W
conversation.line: Almost. I just need to add the figures from June.

conversation.speaker: M
conversation.line: Great. Can you have it ready by Friday morning?

conversation.speaker: W
conversation.line: I'll send it to you Thursday afternoon at the latest.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: 冒頭で「quarterly sales report」と明言されている。

questions.q: What does the woman still need to do?
questions.explanation: 女性の発言「I just need to add the figures from June」と一致。

questions.q: When will the woman send the report?
questions.explanation: 女性の最後の発言「Thursday afternoon at the latest」と一致。

talk: Attention all passengers on Flight 217 to Tokyo. Due to inclement weather at the destination airport, our departure has been delayed by approximately one hour. The new boarding time is 3:45 PM, with departure scheduled for 4:15 PM. Passengers may use the airport lounge during the wait, and complimentary refreshments will be available at Gate 22. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

questions.q: Where is this announcement being made?
questions.explanation: 「Flight 217」「Gate 22」「departure airport」など空港特有の単語が複数使われている。

questions.q: Why has the departure been delayed?
questions.explanation: 「Due to inclement weather at the destination airport」と明言。

questions.q: What is offered to passengers at Gate 22?
questions.explanation: 「complimentary refreshments will be available at Gate 22」と一致。
